svg.aria-label: Six graphs in two rows and three columns: the terms J(t) on -2/3 to 2/5, H(u) on -2/5 to 2/5 and G(u - t) on 0 to 16/15 of the west stress, each on its own vertical scale, with its range written above it. The top row has the terms of Phi_W, J(t; R0), H(u; 0) and G(u - t; 0); the bottom row those of Phi_D, J(t; 0), H(u; R0) and G(u - t; R0). Each curve lies above its dashed chords on either side of 0, where J and H have a convex corner
